claims.statement: For every ordinary arity-2/3/4 path-star profile, every strict descent k of the actual zero-extended parent polynomial satisfies 54k >= 24N - 4a2 - 3a3 - 5.
claims.scope: All m>=1 and all count profiles; every strict descent including terminal zero extension, in particular the actual least strict descent x. This is a parent rank restriction only; it asserts no deletion selector, payment, or mass bound.
claims.reason: Independent exact convolution scan supports the claim through 45 branches, but no all-parameter proof or counterexample was found.

claims.statement: For C=GQ, P=C+zL^(N+1), and E=(1+z)P'-(N+2)P, E=L^(N+1)-2zQ+G*sum_i(1-(r_i-1)z)H_i and [z^k]E=(k+1)P[k+1]-(N+2-k)P[k].
claims.scope: All finite ordinary profiles with r_i in {2,3,4}; polynomial identity over integers with zero-extended coefficients.
claims.reason: Follows by product differentiation and coefficient extraction; the stronger demand that these coefficients be nonnegative at every rank forbidden by the candidate fails at two arity-4 branches and rank 3.

claims.statement: The registered profile-sensitive rank inequality holds at every strict descent for all profiles with 1<=m<=45.
claims.scope: Finite exact computation over all 17,295 count triples with 1<=m<=45, scanning all zero-extended forward differences of the actual parent polynomial.
claims.reason: Integer-convolution replay found 938,431 strict-descent rows and minimum target slack 44; the horizon is finite and proves no universal claim.

limitations: No universal proof or realizable counterexample for the registered rank candidate was obtained.
The packet allowed no source files and required no covered claim IDs; only shared neutral sources and the targeted registered identity were used.
The bounded computation does not certify profiles with more than 45 branches.
